text_block_list.text:
Once we make it back to the front of the 
station, I call out to Transcend.
choice_data_list:
Sorry, but do you mind if I go on my own 
after this?

Sorry, but is it okay if I do my own thing 
after this?

text_block_list.text:
"You see, there are race-related 
procedures to attend to. I couldn't bear 
to drag you along for mere paperwork."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yeah. Sure, fine by me~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Alright, see you back at the academy! 
...Now then. Where should I head to~♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...The branching-ending haunted house, 
'En.' It's as meticulously crafted as 
ever, huh~"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
It was amazing when I came here with 
Trai-chan before... Well, well. I wonder 
how it is after the renewal?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Over already?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. Somehow that felt simpler than 
before. I thought the quality hadn't 
changed, though...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
The New Tech Expo is insane! These 
"Illusion Tiles" are unreal! They're not 
moving, but it totally feels like they 
are!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"...How would Trainy react to this? Uwah~ 
I wanna see~."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm~ Where should I head next~? 
There're plenty of candidates, though.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: I mean, there is, but...

After finishing my paperwork and walking 
through the city, I spotted a familiar 
figure.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Oh, hey, Trai-chan~! Just getting back 
from running errands?
choice_data_list: Yeah, are you on your way somewhere, Tran?

Yeah, Tran, were you on your way 
somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep. Well, I was just wondering where to 
go, though...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Trai-chan, are you free now? ...Then hang 
out with me for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufun. This is it, this is the one. I've 
been curious about this taiyaki~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What on earth is it that "cannot be put 
into words"? ...Shall we dive in and 
uncover the truth~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: *nom*

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...!? What's this, it's spicy... wait, 
sweet? Bitter!?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
What's this? What is this flavor? Behind 
the sweetness there's bitterness, 
spiciness, and sourness... and behind all 
that, yet another taste...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
! ...That's it! Wait, could this be... 
because it's taiyaki, or something like 
that?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. I'm really glad you were here 
with me, Trainy. If I were alone, it 
would've just ended in disaster. Ahaha!
choice_data_list:
I'm telling you, it's no laughing 
matter...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Ahahaha! Trainy, your face is 
priceless! Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ah~. That taste has finally left my 
mouth...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's fine. We're all in the same 
boat here, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if it weren't for me, you might 
never have experienced anything so 
thrilling in your entire life, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Aha. How honest~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Well, though. I guess that goes both 
ways~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "No-pe~? Right, Train-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hey, let's go there sometime soon. That 
haunted house we went to before. I heard 
they renovated it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Also, hit up the New Tech Festa by next 
week, okay? You totally gotta experience 
the Illusion Tiles.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: That's right. There are tons of them~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it kinda just multiplied over the 
course of today, ya know~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Well. It's not like anything's going to 
change, though. Here's to continuing to 
work well together.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. I guess I didn't really need to say 
that out loud.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well then! To my trusty partner, I shall 
give you this!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: The "Indescribable Taiyaki DX"~!
choice_data_list:
...If I go down, you're coming with me, 
you know?

...If I go down, you're coming with me, 
okay?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Totes. I'm not gonna let you shoulder this 
burden all on your own, Trainie-chan.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Let's dive into hell together~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: Bummer.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yikes. Pretty hurt, ngl. Guess that's all 
our relationship really amounted to.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: ...Aha! I already know~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"It's a bit late now, but it's not like I 
don't get that either."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Come on, with the bond between Train-chan 
and me!
